newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp says wine buy under A$10m.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp says wine buy under A$10m.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Friday the purchase of premium Western Australian winery Devil's Lair had cost less than A$10 million.

"From Southcorp's point of view, it does not represent a significant or material investment, but it does provide a direction of where we are going," general manager corporate affairs Glen Cunningham told Reuters.

The purchase took Southcorp into WA's Margaret River, the only major premium wine region in which it lacked a grapegrowing or winemaking presence, and would further its strength and product mix in the super premium wine range, he said.

Southcorp earlier on Friday said it planned to grow the Devil's Lair to 70,000 cases a year over the next five years from its current 10,000 cases and would fully develop potential vineyard area on the 127 hectare property.
